api_acquisition.operation_timeout_enforcement: One owned, bounded metadata-only Python HTTP worker is started at most once for a scoped qualifying run and reused for at most17 fixed GET operations. The parent enforces a whole-operation monotonic deadline including DNS/redirect refusal/body/decode/cleanup, kills its process group and reaps on timeout, and rejects without replacement or retry. urllib socket timeout alone is insufficient.

api_acquisition.cleanup_deadline_rule: Reserve cleanup time inside the same5s whole-operation ceiling, not as an added timeout. A late kill/wait, unreaped worker or missing parent-monitor evidence denies; no assumed successful cleanup or fresh budget after a timeout.
api_acquisition.metadata_worker_transport: Strict bounded request/reply protocol; only enumerated route numbers and validated provider-derived IDs; no arbitrary URL/method/auth/header/code/path injection. At most one reply in flight, bounded by its body+exchange cap and the8MiB ledger; do not reuse target binary IPC as unbounded metadata storage.
api_acquisition.HTTP: HTTPS api.github.com only, GET only, fixed repository prefix, status200, no redirects/retries/conditional cached responses, request Accept-Encoding identity and reject compressed or unexpected content encoding; fixed bounded query strings
api_acquisition.evidence: Preserve exact response-body bytes plus separately serialized exchange provenance: fixed requested URL/method, observed status, Link/content-type/content-encoding/content-length/request-id where returned, monotonic durations, completeness flag and SHA256. Headers/tokens are allowlisted; never record authorization.
api_acquisition.failure_transport: Retain bounded bytes actually obtained and explicit incomplete/oversize/timeout reason, never label a truncated prefix an original complete response or allow PASS.
